backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signals use only close-of-day OHLCV and same-day breadth context known after the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV Close rows for 20-day and 63-day relative strength
derived prior 63-day high known at signal-date close
derived prior fresh-high spacing known at signal-date close

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: 63-day long-base breakouts may work only when market-wide up-volume participation confirms the signal date. This follows the playbook's free-data candidate-pool direction and avoids LLM/state-surface retunes.

2_history_check.exp-20260526-005: Long-base breakout failed Gate 4: aggregate EV -0.0823, PnL +$4,715.76, 2/3 windows improved, late_strong regressed. Retry requires orthogonal source confirmation.
2_history_check.exp-20260526-013_and_014: Volume-breadth breakout established and shared a production-visible market participation context. This run uses its context as confirmation; it does not retune VBB.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-036: Sector-breadth plus market-breadth agreement failed due a late_strong regression. This run tests a different base breakout source, not sector breadth.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Long-base 63-day breakout candidates may have cleaner replacement value when the signal date also passes the existing market volume-breadth participation context.
interpretation: The long-base market-breadth confirmed sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby long-base + breadth thresholds on the same frozen windows without forward paper rows or a materially different source-quality field.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, require forward paper outcomes or a materially different production-visible event/source confirmation field. Do not just retune the long-base or market-breadth thresholds.

source_definition: same signal date must pass exp-20260526-013 market volume-breadth context
stock/ETF exclusions inherited from long-base source
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: Long-base breakout failed only because late_strong regressed while VBB market participation is a validated free-OHLCV context; sample and old-window stability remain risks.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter, daily report exposure, forward replacement-value ledger, and parity tests before any production/report behavior changes.

rejection_reason: aggregate_ev_not_positive; aggregate_pnl_not_positive; window_ev_regression; window_pnl_regression; target_sample_too_small; target_concentration_failed
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe attribution remains sparse; skipped Companyfacts/VBB/VCP scalar retunes because the playbook asks for forward rows; skipped pure long-base threshold retunes because exp-20260526-005 explicitly requires an orthogonal confirmation field.
